intro: Fully funded doctoral researcher position in environmental chemistry (AI4TECS project) at the University of Luxembourg. EUR 44,531 gross/year. Rolling review - early application encouraged.
description:
Project Overview

The University of Luxembourg is hiring a doctoral researcher in environmental chemistry within the AI4TECS project, which develops AI-powered systems for identifying emerging contaminants in water systems. The researcher will combine environmental chemistry with non-target screening using high-resolution mass spectrometry (HRMS) and AI-driven data analysis.

Your Role

  • Develop and apply non-target screening workflows (HRMS) for emerging contaminants
  • Contribute AI-based identification and prioritisation methods for water-quality data
  • Perform extensive laboratory work and collaborate on measurements within the group
  • Publish results and participate in project and network activities
